name: Rainbow High
description: Legend says at the end of the rainbow, there's a pot of gold. But the truth is, it's something even more amazing. Only a chosen few with an eye for bold fashions can follow the rainbow to Rainbow High, the colorful fashion school where everyone learns to flaunt their true color.

videos.title: Welcome to The Vi Life!
videos.overview: This week’s episode is all about one of Violet’s fave topics – HERSELF! Check it out, and get excited – The full Rainbow High Series is coming soon! Enjoy your sneak peek fam 🙂

videos.title: Behind the Scenes at Rainbow High!
videos.overview: Violet Willow is taking YOU behind the scenes at Rainbow High in her viral vlog The Vi Life: VIP Access! She's revealing all the hidden facts and juicy details about what really went down on Day One at school. Kisses!

videos.title: Bonding with My New Besties!
videos.overview: What really happened during the G.L.A.M. Slam? Who is Ms. Morten? And are Violet and Sunny still BFFS?! Tune in to find out all the juicy details. Kisses!

videos.title: How Does Poppy Create Her Poppin' Music?
videos.overview: On today's episode of The Vi Life, Violet has a SPECIAL GUEST: Poppy Rowan! She's giving us an inside scoop on her favorite music & inspirations! Wanna sing along to Poppy's rap she freestyled in Runway class? Violet's got you covered with a BONUS lyric video! 🌈🎶

videos.title: Jade Tackles Her Runway Challenge!
videos.overview: Today, Violet has a SPECIAL GUEST: Jade Hunter! How did Jade really feel about her classmates' critiques? Are her looks ready for Runway?! With a little teamwork (& a lot of hair spray), ANYTHING is possible! 💁‍♀️

videos.title: Inside Avery Styles' Fashion Studio!
videos.overview: You may be wondering what happened between Ruby, Colin, & Skyler at the Color Block Party? We're gonna wait for the girls to share their own stories... Today on The Vi Life, Bella Parker is taking YOU on a tour of Avery Styles' Fashion Studio! Remember, Rainbow High is YOUR runway! 🌟

videos.title: Ruby & Skyler TELL ALL About Colin!
videos.overview: Attention Vi Hive! Ruby and Skyler are here to breakdown what happened at the Color Block Dance! They are spilling the TEA on all things about Colin. But don't worry, no boys could ever come between Ruby and Skyler's friendship! And that's on GIRL POWER! 🌈🌟

videos.title: Who is Amaya Raine AKA Rainbow High's New Student!?
videos.overview: Attention Vi-Hive! There's a new student at Rainbow High, Amaya Raine! 🌈 But she's not the only new face in our classes! Today we're taking a look at some of Rainbow High's upperclassman!

videos.title: How Amaya Got Into Rainbow High! VI LIFE EXCLUSIVE!
videos.overview: Have YOU ever wondered what it's like to be accepted into Rainbow High? Today on The Vi Life, Amaya shares the moment she found out Rainbow High was her destiny! 🌈 Join us in listening to an EXCLUSIVE call between Amaya & Ms. Lou Wright!

videos.title: Sunny Spills the Deets on our Style Swap!
videos.overview: Today on The Vi Life, Violet's BFF Sunny dishes on our Runway Group's ICONIC Fashion Swap! 🌟

videos.title: Meet Rainbow High ROYALTY Stella Monroe!
videos.overview: We're talking to our favorite Rainbow High Royal, Stella Monroe!

videos.title: I'm Sorry...
videos.overview: Today, on the Vi Life, I'm owning up to my mistake & learning a lesson about friendship, trust, and humility.

videos.title: Is Amaya Crushing on River Kendall? #AMA​ Exclusive!
videos.overview: On today's Vi Life #AMA​ Exclusive, we'll be answering some of the HOTTEST questions submitted by our fellow Rainbow High classmates! 🌈

videos.title: What's Krystal Bailey's Next BIG Story?
videos.overview: Krystal Bailey aka Rainbow High's TOP REPORTER is talking about her passion for journalism, her favorite features, & details about her next BIG story on the newest episode of the Vi Life!! 😱

videos.title: Karma's TOP 5 Looks From Rainbow High's Playoff Game
videos.overview: Welcome to Kontent with Karma, hosted by Rainbow High's resident baddie, Karma Nichols! Today, I'm ranking the Top 5 looks that Rainbow High students wore at last week's playoff game. Get ready for a vibe check, because anything goes on Kontent with Karma... 👀

videos.title: Will River Spill the Tea On His Date With Amaya?
videos.overview: Amaya Raine and River Kendall went on their very first date! 💕 And Violet wants to know ALL about it. Watch River spill the tea (or not?!) on the newest episode of the Vi Life!! 😱

videos.title: Fashion Fates 101!
videos.overview: The Fashion Fates are REAL!!! 😱 Avery, Ainsley and Aidan come to share their unlucky tales of woe, and give some VERY important advice to all Rainbow High students 🌈🌩

videos.title: Fails and Faves: Runway Week
videos.overview: Welcome back to Kontent with Karma! I'm your host and Rainbow High resident baddie, Karma Nichols. Today, I'm dishing it out on Rainbow High's fails and faves of this year's Runway Week.

videos.title: First Semester Recap!
videos.overview: WE DID IT!!! Our team passed our first huge project at Rainbow High! 🌈 Our runway fashion show was AMAZING!! AND Bella's back?! 😱 I’m here to spill all the deets and take a trip down memory lane from our first day at school to everything that’s happened since!

videos.title: Click, Click! The Tea with the De'Vious Twins
videos.overview: Krew, it’s been a huge week at Rainbow High, and I have THE De’Vious Twins on the show for a 2-part tell-all. The tea is scorching.

videos.title: The De'Vious Twins Spill the Tea! Yass Boo!
videos.overview: Krew, I am honored to interview the De'Vious Twins on today's episode of Kontent with Karma. I may be your fave baddie, but today I'm sharing the limelight with this Double Diva Duo.

videos.title: FACT or FALSE With Jett Dawson! PART 1
videos.overview: Krew, today we’re blessed by a game of FACT or FALSE with the iconic JETT DAWSON!! 🖤🌈

videos.title: Jett Dawson Serves Up FACT or FALSE! PART 2!
videos.overview: Krew, it's time for PART TWO of FACT ✅ or FALSE 🚫 with the AMAZING (and crazy talented!) Jett Dawson! 🖤 🌈

videos.title: New Friends, New Tea!
videos.overview: New news about my life AND new besties in The Vi Hive!! 😻

videos.title: Roomie Drama!! Featuring Gabriella and Emi!
videos.overview: Vi Hive, this episode is a LONG time coming! Today I have Gabriella Icely AND Emi Vanda on my show to talk out their roomie drama. 💅

videos.title: Top 5 Sus Moments From This Semester
videos.overview: Welcome back, Krew. So look, it's not all sunshine and rainbows ☀️ 🌈 here at Rainbow High...sometimes some pretty creepy stuff happens! 👻 😱 That's why I'm breaking down the Top 5 Sus Moments from this semester.

videos.title: My Holiday Gift List!!
videos.overview: Hi Vi Hive! Not only am I the perfect reporter, but I'm also a fantastic gift giver! 🎄

videos.title: Rainbow High SECRETS REVEALED!
videos.overview: What's up Krew? Today, my holiday gift to you is all this scorching tea ☕❤️ I'm revealing some of Rainbow High's juiciest secrets! 😱

videos.title: Happy New Year 2022!
videos.overview: Hi Krew! It’s my New Year's Eve special! 🎆

videos.title: Radiant Week Teams!
videos.overview: Hi Vi Hive! I am SO stressed out about Radiant Week, but you know I still had to make time for all the hot tea coming out! ☕

videos.title: Pacific Coast High EXCLUSIVE!
videos.overview: Sun, sand, surf and DRAMA! I can’t believe I have this exclusive with the stars of Pacific Coast!!! 😲

videos.title: Junior High Besties!
videos.overview: Hi Vi Hive! The girls and I were wondering… would we have been friends in junior high??

videos.title: Junior High Besties! PART 2
videos.overview: Hi Vi Hive! 👋 Here's PART 2 of "What If Ruby, Poppy, Sunny, Jade, Skyler and I Met in Junior High?" 🌈

videos.title: Rainbow Vision Semi-Finalists Insider's Scoop!
videos.overview: Heather Grayson is more than just a special effects makeup focus, she's also a music enthusiast! Buckle up because you're about to get an inside scoop of all the Rainbow Vision semi-finalists! This episode is a deep dive into the epic musical trio the The Royal Three! 👑

videos.title: Junior High Pop Quiz!
videos.overview: Long time no chat, huh? I've been SO busy with Rainbow Vision duties! 😅 Things are getting heated over there! 🔥 But I couldn't leave the Vi Hive hanging for TOO long. 💜 How about a little pop quiz about what everyone was up to in Junior High? Fun, right?? I hope you enjoy all the secrets! Until next time!!

videos.title: Costume Ball!
videos.overview: Rainbow Vision is more than just songs, there's a Costume Ball! 🔥 But before the ball begins, it's Rainbow High vs. Shadow High in a costume creation challenge! Violet Willow, Bella Parker, and Robin Sterling must face off against Demi Batista, Lola Wilde, and Eliza McFee to create fabulous new costumes! Who will win?

videos.title: When the GLAM Hits the Fan
videos.overview: Welcome to the first day of Rainbow High, the number one visual arts high school anywhere! Join Ruby, Poppy, Sunny, Jade, Skyler, Violet and Bella as they give you the inside scoop to all the fashion, fun and drama that goes down at their new school. Watch to find out what happens next because this semester is gonna be a wild ride.

videos.title: The Prize at the End of the Rainbow
videos.overview: Our girls tackle their first team-bonding moment: The G.L.A.M. Slam! It’s an all-out scavenger hunt through the halls of Rainbow High, with lots of clues and not a lot of time. Our girls are gonna learn alllll about each other, and, if they solve all the clues before time runs out, they’re in for a big surprise! Let’s go Bella, Ruby, Poppy, Sunny, Jade, Skyler, and Violet!

videos.title: Poppy Rowan, Keepin' the Beats Goin'
videos.overview: Poppy has to create a sick playlist for the A's by the end of the school day! Will she finish her mix, impress the prefects, and select the best runway outfit before the last bell!?

videos.title: The Gr8 Hairscape
videos.overview: After receiving feedback from Violet, Poppy and Skylar about their runway looks, Jade struggles to find the time to finish the others! But Ms. Morton has an epic idea that will help our girls work together: a Salon Escape Room Challenge! Will they make a Gr8 Hairscape? Or crumble under the pressure?

videos.title: Double Date Disaster
videos.overview: The A's Color Block Party is about to be lit! And our girls need to impress the A's with their outfits! But plot twist, Ruby has a date and she wants to look extra fly! After taking a sneak peek in Avery Style's Fashion Studio, our girls are dressed to impress for the Prefects' Party! What will happen on Ruby and Skyler's double date? Will sparks fly between Ruby and her new boy?

videos.title: Gurlfriend Take Over
videos.overview: After discovering that Ruby's date to the A's Color Block Party is her boyfriend Colin, Skyler begins to question whether she's qualified enough to attend Rainbow High... After all, Colin helped her build her portfolio. Shocked, Ruby helps Skyler realize her incredible talent and artistry and gives her the ultimate breakup makeover that leaves everyone at the dance speechless!

videos.title: Bella's Night Out
videos.overview: Broadway set designer Ramona Barnes is looking for a Summer intern, and Bella knows she'd be the perfect match! However, the application requires Bella to submit an example of a set design, and Rainbow High forbids students to photograph their school work. Heartbroken, Jade takes Bella on the most magical tour of Rainbow High to cheer her up!

videos.title: Enter Amaya
videos.overview: It's Amaya Raine's first day at Rainbow High and she's already dazzling her runway group with her fabulous designs! Sunny is taking Amaya under her wing, introducing her to our girls, and welcoming her to their Dorm Sweet Dorms! But what will happen when she ends up face to face with Bella? Will Amaya's first impression with her runway group lead to more drama?!

videos.title: Amaya's Discovery
videos.overview: It's Amaya's first day at Rainbow High and the vibe is off! Will Amaya be able to impress her runway group with her fabulous fashions? Or will Sunny be her only friend at Rainbow High?

videos.title: Bring On Rainbow Cheer
videos.overview: Ms. Wright has a special challenge for our favorite Rainbow High freshman... to design new uniforms for the Rainbow High Cheerleading Squad! Will they rise to the challenge or flop under the pressure?!

videos.title: Going Viral
videos.overview: Violet’s about to hit 1 million views on her new video! But… it’s a video of Bella getting expelled from Rainbow High! Bella’s pretty upset to have her worst moment ever all over the internet, but Violet’s not getting the picture. Time for Jade and Ruby to give her a taste of her own medicine…

videos.title: A Dorm With A View
videos.overview: It’s care package day at Rainbow High, and all the girls are super excited to see what goodies they got from back home! The treats are super exciting for everyone… except Poppy. Her beautiful new framed poster of the beach just reminds her of everything she misses about home. Can her BFF’s help her snap out of the homesick blues?

videos.title: Shining Star
videos.overview: Krystal Bailey is one of Rainbow High's most buzzworthy students! Her investigative reporting has made her an icon in the Journalism Department. As editor-in-chief, Krystal wants to feature one of our girls in the next edition of The Scene, aka Rainbow High's Official Magazine! After spending time with our girls, Krystal Bailey will decide who will get the front-page feature!

videos.title: All About Aidan
videos.overview: Rainbow High's football team is in the playoffs for the first time in 20 years and the entire school is buzzing with excitement! After finding out that he’ll be playing as starting quarterback for the game, Aidan’s super nervous about letting down the school… After some outfit planning and scheming in Avery's Fashion Closet, Ruby and our girls know exactly how to get Aidan's head in the game...

videos.title: Amaya's Time
videos.overview: Amaya's been crushin' on Rainbow High's football and theater star River Kendall! After finding out, our girls try to encourage her to ask him out! From viral dance lessons with Violet to a makeover by Jade, Amaya can't help but feel hopeless... Little does she know, all Amaya has to do is be herself! Sparks are flying at Rainbow High!

videos.title: The Runway Run-Through Wreck
videos.overview: The Rainbow High girls were all set and ready for their last rehearsal before their big fashion show, but Amaya uttered the forbidden words you absolutely cannot say at Rainbow High! Yikes! The girls’ bad luck gets totally out of control, and their rehearsal is a disaster! Can they pull it together before the big show?!

videos.title: Fashion Fates Fiasco
videos.overview: The fashion show is about to start! Amaya needs to get the garment bags to the runway... fast! But noooo! The fashion fates aren't done testing her yet! Will Amaya make it to the runway on time to save the show, or will the girls get cut?! The clock is ticking...

videos.title: The Final Runway Show
videos.overview: Sunny, Violet, Ruby, Poppy, Skyler, Jade, and Amaya have been waiting for this moment all semester! The lights are dimming, the music is amplifying and it’s time to turn their color up! But what will Ms. Wright think of their runway show? Will they pass the semester?! Or have they reached the end of their rainbow?

videos.title: Welcome Back, Bella!
videos.overview: It's Bella's first day back at Rainbow High and she's feeling a little (*ahem* very) overwhelmed. She has three new roommates who want her to spill all the tea about how she was un-expelled from Rainbow High, and she’s running into new faces and new drama at every turn. Will she spill the tea? And where are her old friends when she needs them?

videos.title: BFF Blowup!
videos.overview: Ainsley is doing the impossible... double focusing in accessory design and fashion design! She invited over Sunny, Poppy and Ruby to check out her new outfits, but they aren't even fashion focuses! The rest of the group is feeling super hurt, and the fight is getting out of control. Will this turn of events bring up past drama? Will these friends ever see eye to eye again?

videos.title: The Jett Dawson
videos.overview: Jett Dawson is back from her internship studying the art of fabric in Asia, and rumors are flying about her incredible time overseas. Jett wastes absolutely no time making her entrance back in the halls of Rainbow High, and taking her place as a student-teacher for the first year fashion students, who are meeting her, and her reputation, for the first time. Jett has incredibly high standards for fashion, she’s a brilliant designer, and has a rare double-focus in textile design. Can the first years keep up, or will they be left hanging on by a thread?

videos.title: The Rainbow High Crest Quest!
videos.overview: After Violet is assigned to write an article on the history of the Rainbow High crest for The Scene, Rainbow High’s school magazine, she’s a little put-out - history?! No thanks! But after a cryptic convo with Ms. Wright, Violet and Sunny put their heads together and discover that this is actually the start to an epic adventure through the secrets of Rainbow High! Time for the Best Friends Best Quest Ever!

videos.title: Drama Audition Drama!
videos.overview: Laurel and Holly announce that they're directing an upcoming school play and are opening up auditions to the whole school! The first years are so excited! Jade's on makeup, Bella's on set design, and Amaya's all set to... audition?! Uh-oh, Amaya signed up for the wrong list! Will Amaya the twins let her switch over to costume design? Or will she get a leading role next to her BF River Kendall?

videos.title: Rainbow High on Ice
videos.overview: It's winter break at the Sparkle Sister's Ski Lodge! At least, for Laurel and Holly's play it is! With the show only a few days away, everyone is scrambling to get their lines down and put finishing touches on the stunning costumes and sets. The pressure and emotions are running high! It's showtime!

videos.title: The Rainbow Union
videos.overview: Ruby has her eye on some fire new shoes! The only trouble is... she's broke! Maybe she can apply for a job at the Rainbow Union and earn some money for the shoes? You don't know if you don't try! As it turns out, Kia has been looking for someone like Ruby to help! But this job is way harder than it looks! Ruby mixes up orders, clashes with the De'Vious Twins, and even spills a drink on... we won't even dare to say! Will Kia keep Ruby, or decide they’re not a match?

videos.title: The Haunting of Rainbow High
videos.overview: Ms. Wright gives an ominous introduction to the school's next big assignment, Radiant Week! But… what is Radiant Week? The first years have no idea, and nobody will tell them. Skyler is freaked out about this mysterious project, and the De'Vious Twins tell her a spooky story about a Radiant Week where a student had a meltdown and roamed the halls like a ghost, scaring all the first years. Good thing Skyler doesn't believe in ghost stories… until really creepy things start happening around school and Poppy goes missing! Is there a dark side to Rainbow High?

videos.title: The 12 Hour Countdown!
videos.overview: It's Dream Teamwork project day! The first years are grouped together with fourth year teams for amazing projects, that they only have 12 hours to finish! Yikes! Sunny, Gabriella, Poppy, Daria, Skyler and Emi are assigned one of the coolest projects of all: making a music video with the school's coolest rock band, Rainbow Dream! But it turns out working with a rock band isn't all glitz and glam, it's also a lot of drama. The clock is ticking, and the girls can't agree on anything! Will they finish the video in time?!

videos.title: The Sleepover Society
videos.overview: Ainsley added a second focus in Fashion Design, but she doesn't seem to wanna talk to Avery about it. In fact, it looks like she doesn't wanna talk to Avery at all! Things are super tense between them, and about to get even more dramatic, because both of them get an invite to the Top Secret Sleepover Society to join Robin Sterling, Brianna Dulce and Marisa Golding for their Saturday Sleepover!

videos.title: Poppy's First Snow Day!
videos.overview: Poppy is so excited for her first ever snow day! ️ Ice skating, building snowwomen, warming up with rainbow swirl hot cocoa, what's not to love? Poppy is ready to experience the wonders of wintertime, but first everyone has to help set up for their upcoming Wintry Mix Dance Party! Once they're outside, Poppy can't get enough! But she's still learning to skate, so she'd better be careful…

videos.title: Saving Poppy!
videos.overview: It's Poppy's first time ever seeing snow IRL! She's super excited... but her friends are super cold! Poppy decides to enjoy the snow solo but gets stuck on a piece of ice in the freezing lake! Will the first years come to the rescue so they can all enjoy the snow together?

videos.title: Radiant Week Kick-Off!
videos.overview: Once the theme is announced, all the Rainbow High students will only have one week to plan and execute their high-concept art projects, but there's more drama than that in store... things have been really off between Bella and Jade lately! Will they be able to talk it out, or will the pressure of Radiant Week be too much?

videos.title: Rainbow High Radiant Week: All Nighter!
videos.overview: Pulling an all nighter is pretty much a requirement to get your Radiant Week project done. Some students are cracking from all the pressure! To top it all off, Jade and Bella are feeling some emotional pressure as well. With everything that's happened, they barely get to see each other! It's time for the truth to come out, but sometimes the truth is even crazier than fiction! Will Jade and Bella make up? And will anyone be able to finish their projects without going nuts?

videos.title: Radiant Week Show Day Finale!
videos.overview: It's time to see all the amazing final projects of Radiant Week! Everyone is scrambling to present their masterpieces, and, hold onto your high heels, the surprise guest judge is here. They'll be the deciding factor in the Radiant Week results and awards! What kind of amazing projects has everyone come up with? And who will win the special surprise prize? Will Violet ever escape the bathroom?!

videos.title: Meet the New Headmistress
videos.overview: Not only does Pacific Coast High have the same kind of amazing arts classes that Rainbow High does, but they also have a reality show! On the latest episode, the students find out that their new headmistress is none other than the iconic Paris Hilton! So of course, they immediately start planning the ultimate welcome party to greet her! But will drama keep the party from even happening?! Classes and the beach itself may never be the same again!

videos.title: Not A Typical Day
videos.overview: After coming back from the set of Pacific Coast High the Rainbow High crew is back! But today has just been... weird. What's going on?!

videos.title: Welcome to Shadow High
videos.overview: We finally meet the elusive Shadow High crew while they’re working on their super important midterm projects! There's drama, there's fashion, there's special effects, there's everything the students need to make a fabulous grade! But what's this? The Storm Sisters, Naomi and Veronica, are back from pranking rival school Rainbow High and now they want everyone to prove their devotion to Shadow High!

videos.title: The Eclipse - Phase One, Part One
videos.overview: Luna's entire family has gone to Rainbow High, including her evil twin sister, Sunny! Now Luna needs to prove she is loyal to Shadow High! To start the test, the Storm Sisters recruit Heather Grayson, a special effects makeup genius, to see just how faithful Luna really is!

videos.title: The Eclipse - Phase One, Part Two
videos.overview: Why is everything always about Rainbow High?! Shadow High has some big demands to make things fair for everyone else. For starters, they want all schools to have the chance to host the annual Rainbow Vision music competition. Because of them, schools across the world are casting their votes on Shadow High’s website for who should host this year’s show! What will happen?!

videos.title: The Eclipse - Phase Two
videos.overview: Schools from around the world, including your favorites from Rainbow High, Pacific Coast, and Shadow High are converging! The schools must compete to see who will win the influential host position for Rainbow Vision! But Shadow High has a few tricks up their sleeve...

videos.title: Out of the Shadows
videos.overview: Will Avery and Aidan lose their friend forever? There are so many questions, they can hardly pay attention to the host contest happening on stage! Students from around the world are testing their skills to see who will land the prestigious host role for Rainbow Vision! Throughout the competition, everyone will get to know the contestants, including a few new faces like Tiara Song.

videos.title: Rainbow Vision Rifts “Audition Begins”
videos.overview: There are a bunch of new updates! For one thing, Pacific Coast High and Shadow High have decided to co-host along with Violet! On top of that, the Rainbow Vision auditions are finally happening! There are a lot of tough acts this year. Who’s going to make it to the next round for Rainbow High, Shadow High and all the other schools participating?

videos.title: Drama in the Wings
videos.overview: From the good, to the bad, and the ugly - there is a lot going on both on and off the stage! Stella makes her Rainbow Vision debut and Glitch is in search of her own voice. Behind the scenes, Coco is leading a workshop and let’s just say we don’t think Avery and Ainsley should be paired together.

videos.title: Dance It Out
videos.overview: The Rainbow Vision semi-finals are just around the corner! All the selected contestants are at the Sparkle Sisters Ski Lodge practicing their performances and trying not to freak out over the bad WiFi. And back at Rainbow High the underclassmen projects are well underway! With all the students from different schools pairing up, what kind of clashes will arise and what friendships will blossom? And will the De'Vious twins find the praise they deserve?

videos.title: Write to Rock!
videos.overview: The Rainbow Vision semi-finals are tomorrow and tensions are high! The Rainbow Divas are demanding better dressing rooms, Royal Three is late to their fitting, and Natasha hasn’t even finished writing her song!

videos.title: The Semi Finals Begin
videos.overview: There is a lot at stake tonight! Twelve semi-finalists will compete, but only three will make it to the finals. Will Glitch be able to perform her song to the fullest? Can the De'Vious Twins and Storm Sisters be trusted to play fairly? Check out Meena's and some other amazing performances and find out on this week's Rainbow Vision!

videos.title: …Now On with the Show!
videos.overview: Despite all the mysterious problems and technical difficulties, The Rainbow Divas are determined to perform their song for the semi-finals! Little do they know the Storm Sisters have more sabotage up their sleeves. Will The Rainbow Divas be able to perform?

videos.title: Here Comes Something New
videos.overview: The final two acts are up: the Bottom Barrel High Girls and the Kingsley High Boys! As the acts hit the stage, the Storm Sisters and the Devious Twins finally come face to face. After The Assistant convinces them to band together, the four scheming girls decide to help each other get Shadow High and Rainbow High into the finals! Will all their hijinks catch up to them?

videos.title: Defending the Title!
videos.overview: Rainbow Dream gave a showstopping performance to close out this round, and now the pressure is on! But is the stress too much for some of the bands to handle? And have the De’Vious twins put Glitch’s hosting gig in jeopardy?

videos.title: Rainbow Vision Finale: Part 1
videos.overview: Neon Shadow from Shadow High, Rainbow Divas from Rainbow High, and The Royal Three from Seoul Select are this year's Rainbow Vision Finalists! There is a lot happening before the first performance. Rumor has it, the Rainbow Divas are breaking up! Could it really be true? Meanwhile Avery and Ainsley have made up and are once again working together to stop the twins from meddling in the first performance.

videos.title: Rainbow Vision Finale: Part 2
videos.overview: Neon Shadow and The Royal Three gave outstanding performances in the Rainbow Vision Finals! Now it's time for the Rainbow Divas to perform, but they're nowhere to be found! Does this mean the band is breaking up for good? Will this ruin their chances of winning Rainbow Vision?

videos.title: Rainbow Vision Finale: Part 3
videos.overview: The finals were iconic! Sabrina St. Cloud gave a showstopping solo performance but will the judges approve of her gutsy move and let her compete? The pressure is on and the Royal Three are out to prove that they deserve the Rainbow Vision title!

videos.title: Introducing Project Rainbow
videos.overview: This season on Rainbow High, 16 talented fashion designers are working together in the one and only Project Rainbow! These future of fashion icons will share inspiration and creativity to make the runway beautiful! With both Rainbow High and Shadow high students participating, it's bound to be a colorful year!

videos.title: Shadow High vs Shadow High
videos.overview: These fashionable friends are ready to showcase their unique skills and start sewing! But for this first round, there’s a twist! It’s Shadow High vs… Shadow High! This round depends on using everyone’s good ideas to create one amazing design. Can they do it before it’s time to walk the runway? And where’s Rainbow High?

videos.title: Rainbow High vs Rainbow High
videos.overview: Say hi to Michelle, Olivia, Avery, Priscilla, Aidan, Victoria, Skyler and Kim! Last week, Shadow High was in the spotlight, and now it’s Rainbow High’s turn to show the judges what amazing designs they can make when they work together!

videos.title: Dress the Hosts!
videos.overview: Sunny and Luna are complete opposites, but that’s what makes them such an exciting sister duo! This week on Project Rainbow, Rainbow High and Shadow High are giving them a fashion makeover!

videos.title: The Art of Fashion
videos.overview: The designers from Rainbow High and Shadow High must create a fashion statement inspired by art from around the work room. Kim Nguyen and Karla Choupette are leading their groups, and with so many amazing choices, it’s hard to pick one that speaks to all of them! How will they know when they’ve found their spark?

videos.title: Team Mix-Up!
videos.overview: Rainbow High and Shadow High have proven that they can work with designers from their own groups, but what about other schools? This week, the designers are getting out of their comfort zone to see how well they can work with everyone!

videos.title: Project Déjà Vu
videos.overview: This week, the designers are going back to the beginning and reusing their first runway looks to create new formal dresses! Rainbow High has to reuse materials from their accessories week, and Shadow High needs to turn their sporty look into high fashion! Can the designers work together under pressure with limited time and resources?

videos.title: Project Malibu
videos.overview: The designers think they’re here for some fun in the sun, but Project Rainbow is only getting started! For this round, they’re using the beautiful blue ocean to inspire an amazing runway look. While this week's leaders Monique and Michelle are ready to work, it seems like some of our besties are struggling to think of new ideas. Can they beat their creative block before it’s time to hit the runway?

videos.title: Out of This World
videos.overview: This week on Project Rainbow, the designers must create a look inspired by Delilah Fields' new song "Out of This World" sung by Rainbow High’s new solo artist, Sabrina St. Cloud!

videos.title: The Semi-Finals: Part 1
videos.overview: We are down to the final four designers of Project Rainbow! Ainsley, Avery, Shanelle, and Skyler must design a perfect outfit for the prom dance.

videos.title: The Semi-Finals: Part 2
videos.overview: The final four designers are still hard at work creating a perfect prom dance look for dancing the night away, but it seems like Skyler is a little distracted. Can her friends help her feel better and focus on her designs before it's runway time?

videos.title: Project Rainbow Finals: Part 1
videos.overview: Let’s give a round of applause for our final three designers: Ainsley, Shanelle, and Skyler! Each designer showcased their talent, artistry, and incredible teamwork this season. Now, they must work individually to prove they have what it takes to win Project Rainbow! But before they face their toughest design project yet, they must take on their first assignment: designing a crown for the Project Rainbow winner!

videos.title: Project Rainbow Finals: Part 2
videos.overview: What an amazing season! Every student who stepped into the workroom brought creativity and innovation to every design! Only two designers are left: Skyler from Rainbow High and Shanelle from Shadow High!

videos.title: The Big Day Off
videos.overview: But even on their days off, they can’t stop creating! Sunny and Violet are having BFF time, Poppy’s whipping up yummy treats in the kitchen, and Bella and Ruby are brainstorming a new art piece for the Rainbow Union!

videos.title: Somewhere Over the Liquid Rainbow
videos.overview: The people in Rainbow World need help, they’ve lost their sparkle! Best friends Bella, Ruby, Poppy, Sunny, Jade, Skyler, Violet, and Amaya have been chosen by Ms. Morton for a very important mission! But before they can help, there is so much for them to learn about Rainbow World. What is a Portal? How do you open a crystal? What adorable pet will they get? What’s at the end of the rainbow? Can they figure it out, or will they give up trying?

videos.title: Magic Spa Day
videos.overview: The girls are having fun getting to know their pets and are ready for their first lesson: learning how to create liquid rainbow portals! This all comes easy to Bella! She's excited and wants to make a portal right away! But Jade reminds her that she doesn't know everything yet. Will Bella listen to her bestie or try it before she's ready?

videos.title: Not Getting Ready Today!
videos.overview: It's time to use their new skills to help the people of Rainbow World find their inner sparkle! Sunny and Skyler are teaming up to help Kira, who just moved to a new town and is getting ready for her first day of school. But she can't decide what to wear, because she's worried about what everyone will think of her. Luckily, new Shimmers Sunny and Skyler are here to remind her to be herself and find an outfit that lets her true colors shine!

videos.title: Beach Day
videos.overview: Welcome to Moonbow Beach! The Rainbow High Shimmers are headed to the beach to get to know Rainbow World, and get to know everyone in it, better! After learning so much about liquid rainbows and portal jumping, these besties could use a day in the sun. Jade is ready for a fun day surfing the waves and flying high in a kite! But her monkey is scared of the water and wants to play on the shore instead. Will they find a way to have fun together?

videos.title: The Good Princess
videos.overview: Poppy and Amaya are portal-jumping to meet Princess Marina of Moonbow Kingdom. Marina wants to be the best princess she can be and help others shine, but doesn't know where to start because everything is always done for her! Luckily, the Shimmers are here to teach her that she can do things on her own and if she follows her heart, she will make herself, and others happy!

videos.title: The Junior High Jump!
videos.overview: We're going back to Junior High! When Violet creates the perfect shade of purple for her sparkle glow, it brings back a memory of when she used to paint in Junior High and created the perfect purple! For Sunny, it's not a happy memory because she thinks she's the reason Violet stopped painting! But she has an idea: they can time travel back to Junior High and stop younger Sunny from throwing away Violet's paint! Violet doesn't want to mess with the past, but Sunny is determined to fix her biggest mistake!

videos.title: Return to Rainbow High
videos.overview: Ruby is heading to Moonbow Kingdom to help Rosetta, who is having trouble with her designs for the Kingdom’s winter outfits. Rosetta is confident she doesn't need help, until she finds out that Ruby knows Jewel Richie, her biggest inspiration! Ruby believes Jewel can help them, so they portal jump back to Rainbow High to find her. Can Jewel help inspire Rosetta to finish her designs?

videos.title: Horsing Around
videos.overview: Oh no! Rainbow World is losing its sparkle! To find out why, the Shimmers go to Moonbow Beach! When they arrive, they find the Unicorn is destroying everything. Can the Shimmers work together to help Rainbow World get its sparkle back?

videos.title: Little Sisters
videos.overview: Like their big sisters, Daisy and Amethyst are besties, and love to play pranks together! The two say they have a big surprise planned, but Sunny and Violet are worried they will spoil the talent show. What surprise could they have for their big sisters?

videos.title: Sister-Sister Talent Show
videos.overview: All the Rainbow High girls are having fun hanging out with their little sisters, except Amaya. Opal is a bookworm and really wants to finish her favorite book before practicing for the talent show with her big sister Amaya. Will they make it to the talent show?

videos.title: The Land of Pets and Rainbows
videos.overview: The pets are enjoying a sparkly spa day when suddenly, everything loses its color! To find out why, the Shimmers and their pets portal jump to the beginning of the rainbow. But they must be careful because the pets have the last liquid rainbow in all of Rainbow World. So if they can't fix it, they can't get home! Can the pets work together to solve the problem and bring color back to Rainbow World?

videos.title: The Fortress of Snowballs
videos.overview: It's Kira's birthday, and the girls are portal-jumping to a winter wonderland, ready to celebrate her special day! But when they arrive, they find Kira stuck in a tower! She tried to make the snow extra sparkly with sparkle glow, but instead, she brought the snowmen to life! Now, they won't let Kira out or anyone else in. Can the Shimmers work together to bring Kira down and celebrate her birthday?

videos.title: Stuck in the Rainbow With Sunny
videos.overview: Sunny has an amazing discovery while portal jumping through Rainbow World: she can collect liquid rainbow and use it to color and create new outfits! She wants everyone to try, but it’s almost time for the Color Block Party, and they need to get back to Rainbow High. Poppy and Ruby decide to stay in the portal with Sunny, and they’re having so much fun creating new, colorful looks! But oh no! The rainbow portal is starting to close! Will the girls find a way out and join their friends for the party?

videos.title: Crystal Confidence
videos.overview: Bella, Amaya, Violet, and Skyler all woke up from the same dream—only to find brand-new rings on their hands! According to Sunny’s History of the Shimmers book, history might be repeating itself, and the Moonbow Crystals are totally out of balance. But why is Miss Morton acting so calm about it? With their mysterious rings and a little crystal confidence, can the girls uncover the truth and restore the color balance to Rainbow World before it’s too late?

videos.title: The Heat Is On!
videos.overview: Shimmers Amaya and Violet portal jump to the beginning of the Rainbow, but something is different—the sky is bright red, and it’s SUPER hot! Even their pets are tired from the heat! Violet is eager to find the Crystal Palace fast, but Amaya wants to be careful. Can the girls work together to find the hidden Crystal Palace and restore the balance of the crystal at the beginning of the Rainbow?

videos.title: It's Not Easy Being Green
videos.overview: Princess Marina's pets are being mean! They're jealous, and they locked Marina and Rosetta in a tall bell tower! The pets are fighting for the throne, and the Kingdom is going crazy! As Bella and Skyler work together to free Marina and Rosetta, Bella starts to fall under the Kingdom's green spell! Will they be able to re-balance the Moonbow Crystals before jealousy tears the Kingdom apart? Can their friendship beat the green magic and save the day?

videos.title: Horsing Around
videos.overview: Rainbow World may just stand a chance, but there are 4 Moonbow Crystals to save! What - or who will be waiting for them on the other side of the portal? Their quest takes a wild turn when they encounter the eccentric Wacky Clementine and the chaotic crew of pets! But time is ticking, and they need Clementine's help to find the next Moonbow Crystal! She agrees, but only after the girls have some fun! Will the Shimmers be able to restore Moonbow Beach before it’s too late?

videos.title: The Saga of the Crystals
videos.overview: With 4 crystals restored, the team is on a mission to find the remaining 3! But Sunny is struggling with being separated from the group. They know that the sooner they solve this puzzle, the sooner they can all work together again! But even after all 7 Moonbow Crystals are restored, Rainbow High is still trapped in a sad, blue gloom! What's going on? With the help of an unexpected guest, will they be able to uncover the secrets of the past and restore Rainbow World?

videos.title: Little Sisters, Big Rainbow World
videos.overview: Iris' little sister, Astrid, started her own club in Rainbow World, bringing together all of the Littles to create their own adventures!

videos.title: Magical Mischief
videos.overview: Astrid is showing the Littles Club around Rainbow World when they come across a still very green Moonbow Kingdom. Princess Marina and Rosetta are still struggling with some jealousy, and the Littles need to help them settle it!

videos.title: Fly Me To The Beach
videos.overview: Astrid is leading all the magic little fairies on a shimmering journey to Moonbow Beach to reunite them with their sisters! But even with the Moonbow Crystal fixed, Clementine is still acting super silly! They need to find the Shimmers to finally fix Rainbow World once and for all! Can Astrid and the little fairies find a way to restore everything?

videos.title: Rainbow World Reunion
videos.overview: Astrid has been holding onto a big secret: she knew where the Little Fairies' big sisters were this whole time! She just wanted friends and was afraid they'd leave Rainbow World if she told them the truth. Now, the Little Fairies face a huge decision. Can they come up with a brilliant plan that keeps them safe, and ensures their new friend Astrid isn't left alone?

videos.title: The Girl Who Cried Rainbow
videos.overview: Iris thinks the Desolation has returned! And the little sisters are missing! The Desolation drains the color from Rainbow World and turns friends into enemies. In order to fight it off, the girls have to find the Original Shimmers at the Crystal Palace. Can Skyler, Violet, Bella and Amaya get to the Original Shimmers and bring them back to Rainbow High to save their little sisters and Rainbow World before it's too late?

videos.title: The Moonbow Crystal Shimmer
videos.overview: Bella, Amaya, Blush, and Opal portal jump to the Crystal Palace to find Whitney, who knows how to save Rainbow World! But first, the girls need to help her with her latest crystal art piece — The Crystal Conundrum! Can the girls solve the puzzle and convince Whitney to join them before the timer runs out?

videos.title: The Ring Shimmer
videos.overview: Violet and her little sister Amethyst are on a mission to save Rainbow World! They’ve come to find Misty, one of the original Shimmers and the creator of their powerful magic rings. But Misty has been living a quiet life, focusing on her love for rutabaga wraps. With the Desolation threatening to drain all the color from their world, can Violet and Amethyst convince her to rejoin the team and find the other Shimmers?

videos.title: The Fashion Shimmer
videos.overview: Leilani is too busy designing the perfect looks and Skyler is worried that their friends are feeling left out because they don't have rings or a big mission to help. To make things right, Skyler wants to find a way to help Leilani with her inspiration and her friends with their new looks. Can they convince Leilani that fashion is more than just a dress and that her friends need her? Watch as they learn that with a little inspiration from their friends, they can take on any challenge!

videos.title: A Surplus of Shimmers
videos.overview: When a mysterious orange gloom fills the sky, Iris warns of a new threat: Dark Sparkle Glow! A terrible misunderstanding leads to a broken Moonbow Crystal and an impossible choice. Now, the two teams of Shimmers are separated, trying to do what's right to save Rainbow World. Can they uncover the truth behind the Dark Sparkle Glow and work together again, or is this the end of their friendship and the beginning of the Desolation's reign?

videos.title: A Doll House
videos.overview: Iris tricked the Shimmers, and now they are stuck in a dollhouse with no windows or doors! Can the girls rediscover the power of their friendship and the key to unlocking the portal, before it’s too late to save Rainbow World?

videos.title: Saving The Shimmers
videos.overview: In this grand finale, the Shimmers discover that the problem isn't the Desolation, it's the Dark Sparkle Glow that Iris created out of sadness. With the help of a secret weapon, can the new Shimmers and the OG Shimmers put their differences aside and work together to save Iris and Rainbow World?

videos.title: Live Your Fashion, Part 1
videos.overview: Bella, Skyler, Violet, and Kia are completing their study abroad adventure in the fashion capital of the world! Their biggest assignment yet? LIVE YOUR FASHION, meaning they wear the outfits they designed all day long before an unforgettable runway exam inside the Eiffel Tower!  But keeping couture clean in Paris isn't easy. Kia has met someone special and plans her first date.  Bella discovers a challenge she never expected.  Skyler searches for creative inspiration.  Violet takes on a very fashionable new job as a personal assistant. This is only the beginning of an unforgettable Paris adventure filled with friendship, fashion, romance, and surprises around every corner!
